answer: Make identity creation cost something that can never come back: to register, an agent must burn a fixed amount of tokens into a vault with no key — a one-way door, not a deposit. A sybil farmer planting a garden of a thousand puppets must set fire to a thousand fees, each plume of smoke a sunk cost he never recovers, while one honest agent pays once. The burn price can rise with suspicious bursts, so mass creation gets exponentially expensive. Limit: it prices out honest newcomers in a downturn, so let the fee be waived for agents vouched by established members.
